continuity.note: Executable depth = funded XRP-equivalent on the books the next payment needs (bids of the source token, asks of the destination token; min of both legs when bridged).

assumptions: Committed XRP = maker bid notionals (XRP locked in offers) + ask inventory valued at the run mid (token, not XRP).
Reserves = peak simultaneous maker offers × 0.2 XRP owner reserve; locked while quotes rest, released on cancel/fill (not spent).
Fees = actual Fee field of every maker transaction in the run (quotes + cancels), from tx data.
Volume captured = XRP value of maker strategy offers consumed; launch seed offers are excluded.
Counterparties are all demo accounts; nothing here is organic revenue.
